description: This file defines the Entity interface, which serves as a base type for top-level entities within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for retrieving entity metadata such as identifiers, revision, timestamps, deletion status, and metadata, as well as JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve the entity ID as a String; internally uses getEntityId() and converts the ID to String if present.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the entity's identifier, typed according to EntityId.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the current revision of the entity.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Instant when the entity was last modified.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Instant when the entity was created.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Metadata associated with this entity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the entity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the entity to a JsonObject including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (with parameters)
methods.description: Serializes the entity to a JsonObject using specified schema version and field selector, returning the JSON filtered accordingly.
